source.title: Remarks and open problems on the minimum permanent of acyclic doubly stochastic matrices

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 6141117. The local resolver row for this identifier exposed DOI 10.1080/03081087.2012.675332, and independent DOI/title search metadata identified the exact work as C.M. da Fonseca, "Remarks and open problems on the minimum permanent of acyclic doubly stochastic matrices," Linear and Multilinear Algebra 61(3), pages 281-293, 2013.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only/paywalled_or_restricted. Direct shell fetches of https://zbmath.org/6141117, the DOI redirect, the Taylor & Francis full-article page, and the Taylor & Francis PDF endpoint returned Cloudflare challenge HTTP 403 responses. Web-indexed Taylor & Francis pages exposed citation details, abstract, keywords, table-of-contents entries, and PDF labels, but not the article body or complete problem statements.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by the exact DOI, DOI suffix, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus arXiv, exact title plus ResearchGate, OpenAlex work id W2138187596, and the Taylor & Francis issue table of contents. Candidate pages were rejected because they were publisher abstract/access pages, bibliographic metadata, table-of-contents listings, search snippets, ResearchGate citation/context snippets, or related/citing works rather than a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical open-problem statements.
